todos: P2 - PROCESS CLOSURE DEFECT ON INACCESSIBLE INSTANCE - AUDIT-41 (2026-10-22): CloseOwnedApplication.ps1 line 13 crashes with PropertyNotFoundException on $process.MainModule.FileName when any process named OnlyWinget has an inaccessible or null MainModule (e.g. running under different elevation, session, or restricted access), and catch block misses Win32Exception and PropertyNotFoundException. Evidence: Empirically reproduced during typecheck on PID 24608 where scripts/run.ps1 -Task Typecheck failed with exit code 1; once process exited, typecheck passed with code 0. Impact: Causes build.ps1, clean.ps1, typecheck.ps1 and NSIS uninstaller/installer (CloseOwnedApplication.nsh) to abort immediately with an unhandled exception or blocking dialog whenever an inaccessible OnlyWinget process exists. Scope: scripts/support/CloseOwnedApplication.ps1, src/OnlyWinget.Setup/CloseOwnedApplication.nsh, scripts/test-process-ownership.ps1. Dependencies: None. Completion criterion: Handle null or inaccessible MainModule gracefully without throwing, verify unowned processes are safely ignored, and pass regression test covering an inaccessible or null-MainModule process.

P2 - CLI AND PRESET INPUT VALIDATION GAP - AUDIT-42 (2026-10-22): Project constraint requires rigorous input validation for JSON preset import and winget CLI parameters. WingetInputValidator.Validate is implemented and enforced in WingetCommandBuilder and SourcesViewModel, but is missing during preset import in PresetDocumentService.Import, during package search in WingetPackageSearchService.SearchAsync, and during package show/resolve in WingetPackageResolver.ResolveAsync. Evidence: Static audit of PresetDocumentService.cs (only checks null and duplicates, no character validation on Id/Source), WingetPackageSearchService.cs (passes query and source directly), and WingetPackageResolver.cs. Impact: Malformed or hostile inputs in imported preset files or search queries bypass domain validation and reach external CLI processes unvalidated. Scope: src/OnlyWinget.Application/Presets/PresetDocumentService.cs, src/OnlyWinget.Infrastructure/Winget/WingetPackageSearchService.cs, src/OnlyWinget.Infrastructure/Winget/WingetPackageResolver.cs, tests/OnlyWinget.Tests. Dependencies: None. Completion criterion: Enforce WingetInputValidator validation across preset import and search/resolve CLI boundaries, and verify rejection with unit tests covering control characters and disallowed tokens.
